name: China University of Geosciences (Wuhan)
supervisors: Ministry of Education (co-built with the Ministry of Land and Resources)

evidence.summary: CUG (Wuhan) has rules for managing the defence science and technology projects it undertakes, under which a project starts only once its unit and leader have signed a secrecy responsibility agreement with the university.
Run by the Ministry of Education since 2000, when it passed from the Ministry of Land and Resources; the two ministries signed an agreement to co-build it in 2006.
